title: Placement Training Test - Verbal Ability & Logical Reasoning - Day 15
description: A fresh placement-style assessment focused on verbal ability, logical reasoning, analytical thinking, critical reasoning, and professional communication.

questions.question: Choose the word that best completes the sentence: The instructions were so ___ that every candidate understood exactly what was required.
Five students P, Q, R, S and T are standing in a row. P is to the left of Q. R is to the right of Q. S is to the left of P. T is to the right of R. Who is in the middle?
Choose the grammatically correct sentence.
options: Neither the employees nor the manager were aware of the change.
Neither the employees nor the manager was aware of the change.
Neither the employees or the manager was aware of the change.
Neither employees nor the manager were aware of the change.

questions.question: All analysts are careful. Some developers are analysts. Which conclusion definitely follows?
A company's customer complaints decreased after it introduced a new support system. Which conclusion is most reasonable?
options: The new support system may have contributed to the decrease.
The new support system definitely eliminated all customer problems.
Customer complaints can only be reduced through support systems.
Every customer prefers the new support system.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to 'diligent'.
Four tasks W, X, Y and Z must be completed one after another. W must be before Y. X must be before Z. Which sequence is possible?
A company requires every candidate who reaches the final interview stage to complete a technical assessment. Meena did not complete the technical assessment. What can definitely be concluded?
options: Meena definitely reached the final interview stage.
Meena cannot be confirmed as having reached the final interview stage.
Meena was definitely rejected by the company.

questions.question: Which sentence is most appropriate for a professional email requesting an extension?
options: Give me more time because I cannot finish this.
I won't finish it today, so extend the deadline.
Could you please consider extending the deadline by one day due to the additional work required?
The deadline is impossible, so you need to change it.

questions.question: A team is deciding between two solutions. Solution A is cheaper but slower, while Solution B is faster but more expensive. What should the team do first?
options: Compare both solutions against the project's cost, time and requirements.
Let the most senior team member decide without discussion.
